what: Refactored sv-memory init to interactively prompt users for which AI coding assistants to configure, added --agent, --agents, and --all flags, automated Git post-commit hook installation upon init, and unified Cursor/Windsurf/Git platforms across hooks status and setup.
why: Running sv-memory init previously auto-installed hooks and skills for all 6 assistants unconditionally on fresh repositories, creating unwanted configuration files across multiple editors/CLIs, and did not install the Git post-commit hook for passive memory capture.
learned: Interactive multi-select with pre-selection makes initialization clean and prevents cluttering repositories with unused assistant config files; git post-commit hooks should always be wired automatically when .git exists.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
